title: The Rip in the Bin
lines: Mom and Sid sit at a bin.
Mud can rot in a hot bin.
A rip is in the bin.
"A rat can hop in," said Mom.
Sid taps a mat on the rip.
The rat can not hop in the bin.
The rat naps on a pot.
"The rat is not in the bin," said Sid.
scoring_note: This passage says "can not", "is not". Decodability forbids apostrophes. A child who reads "can't" or "isn't" is reading for meaning — do not score it an error.
